nodes.label: Fair Gamification
nodes.rationale: Rewards reliability and advance planning while excluding approved sick and emergency leave, reducing presenteeism and popularity bias.

nodes.label: Deterministic Simulation with Local NLP
nodes.rationale: Separates deterministic calculations from language generation so every numeric result remains trustworthy and auditable.

nodes.label: FastAPI Modular Monolith
nodes.rationale: Provides module boundaries and future extraction seams without the operational overhead of microservices.

nodes.label: Provisional Emergency Leave
nodes.rationale: Auto-provisional approval prioritizes urgent real-world absence handling while preserving retroactive review and abuse controls.

nodes.label: Fair Recognition System
nodes.rationale: Measures unplanned absence and planning discipline rather than total leave, explicitly avoiding incentives for unhealthy presenteeism.

nodes.label: Local Privacy-Preserving SLM
nodes.rationale: Ollama and a small quantized model avoid third-party API calls, preserve employee-data privacy, and fit hackathon hardware.

nodes.label: Dependency-Ordered Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: The build sequence is ordered by dependency so later modules can rely on stable foundations and shared contracts.

nodes.label: Shared Change Request Foundation
nodes.rationale: Built before Employee and Payroll to avoid duplicating approval, diff, rejection, and effective-date logic.

nodes.label: Authentication and Authorization Foundation
nodes.rationale: Authentication precedes other modules because every protected workflow requires a current user and role.

nodes.label: Deterministic Simulation Engine Implementation
nodes.rationale: Pure computation is implemented and tested before AI integration so the chatbot rests on a demonstrably accurate source of truth.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith Architecture
nodes.rationale: A single deployable application with table ownership and service contracts preserves low operational overhead and future service extraction.

nodes.label: Service-Only Module Boundary Rule
nodes.rationale: Cross-module consumers use service functions and Pydantic schemas rather than importing another module's SQLAlchemy models, reducing latent coupling.

nodes.label: Future Service Extraction Path
nodes.rationale: Simulation is easiest to extract because it is stateless, Payroll benefits from security isolation, and Auth is a universal service dependency.

nodes.label: Fair Gamification Summary
nodes.rationale: Recognition should reward reliability and advance planning without penalizing legitimate rest.

nodes.label: Auditable Local AI Design
nodes.rationale: The model parses and phrases language while deterministic code owns every number.

nodes.label: Backend Integration Contract
nodes.rationale: Frontend mocks and backend responses must match api.yaml, and breaking changes must be communicated before merging.

nodes.label: Suggested MVP Delivery Order
nodes.rationale: Roles and shared API shapes precede screen construction, followed by incremental real-endpoint integration and end-to-end testing.

nodes.label: MVP Scope Deferrals
nodes.rationale: Notifications, reporting, payslips, storage, advanced payroll, and audit history are deferred unless time permits.

nodes.label: Fair Gamification Design
nodes.rationale: The system avoids rewarding zero absence, excludes approved leave from streak failures, weights admin votes, and makes the leaderboard opt-in.

nodes.label: Two-Layer Trust Architecture
nodes.rationale: Deterministic computation owns numeric truth while local NLP only parses intent and humanizes structured results.

nodes.label: Module Dependency Rule
nodes.rationale: Dev B modules consume Dev A modules only through Pydantic schemas and service functions, never direct SQLAlchemy-model imports.
